notes: The engineer dashboard now says what it means: the Field table no longer paints a gap you are closing on the car ahead as bad news, consistency is measured on laps that can be compared instead of reading 23 seconds after one spin, the fuel line cannot call a pit stop off a missing number, and the corner lights are no longer below the bottom of a 1080p screen. Buttons that are switched off look switched off. On the phone, one missing field no longer leaves the whole companion app blank. Includes all of 0.9.148: SMART answering only from your own data, and a rebuilt idea of what counts as a lap.
